source_text: Asor incendit; ceteras urbes stantes reliquit. Terra quievit a bellis. Perfecta victoria quietem parit. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Hazor he-burns; other cities standing he-left. Land rested from wars. Perfect victory rest begets. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[He burns Hazor >> Bible:Joshua 11:10-13]]; other cities he leaves standing. [[The land rested from war >> Bible:Joshua 11:23]]. Complete victory begets rest. Amen.
